prior_exposure: All game targets and English authors previously exposed. New protocol precedes the new codec outcomes, not historical exposure.
gate: In each content cell, at least27/30aligned targets strictly prefer codes and at least27/30clipped targets strictly prefer raw. Ties fail. Failure prevents mechanism identification on game data.

coding.common: 1bit family selector + Elias gamma(raw_target_length+1); literal0 +4bit digit; reference1 +ceil(log2(number_of_source_books))bit book index.
coding.objective: Exact minimum total bit length, no English scoring; all raw reference lengths1..96; cheapest witness per raw string, ties by bitstring.
coding.side_information: Ordered source raw books and complete compatible boundary annotations are shared by both models. These are CONDITIONAL target bits; source/annotation description cost is not included.
coding.decoder: Actual prefix bitstreams roundtrip; reference length inferred from addressed source; no cross-book source snippets, no target dictionary learning.

primary_target: Previously exposed137digit Kharos; fitted dictionaries contain only70Hellgate books.

target_controls.score: Delta=codes_bits-raw_bits. Exploratory upper tail rank per mode; no hypothesis-test or semantic claim.

secondary_game_evaluation: Two raw16-overlap components68+2, each predicted only from the other. Previously exposed and tiny; shorter/transformed leakage persists. Sum conditional target bits, not independence of windows.
translation_gate: No code-to-English output in this experiment. A copying mechanism does not identify a cipher, true tokenization, or semantic content.
